description: This file defines the BatchOperation class, which manages batch operations for the Android Contacts provider, allowing addition of operations and execution of batch with proper error handling and result aggregation.

classes.name: BatchOperation
classes.description: Handles execution of batch operations on the Contacts provider, allowing for adding operations and executing them with error handling.

methods.name: BatchOperation
methods.description: Constructor initializing the BatchOperation with a context and content resolver.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of operations currently queued.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a ContentProviderOperation to the batch.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the batch operations via ContentResolver, returns list of resulting URIs, and clears the operation list.
